title: Jumping and walking across the town
caption: Jump onto curbs, benches and the fountain rim, then walk off. The third consecutive jump becomes a somersault, and walking stays at normal speed after entering an area.

sections.title: Fountain and curb movement repair
sections.caption: Jumping beside an edge works, and birds and water effects do not block movement. Desktop Auto/High jump CPU time fell from 41.7 to 1.2 ms in the measured test; both desktop and phone playthroughs passed.
